title: Sign-off returned from a generated page (JSON file or mail attachment)
description: Carries references and decisions only, never names. input_sha256 binds the decision to the exact inputs the page showed, so a changed input makes the sign-off stale.

id.description: Unique per page render; a repeat id is a no-op

decision.description: revoke (decision 0019, added within major 1) withdraws the approval in force of a step whose done_when declares revocable: true; it carries the same input_sha256 as that approval and a written fields.reason.
